candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. E no dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. I count the pikin breath for one full minute before treatment. I do bronchodilator trial finish. I see say chest no sink inside before treatment. Pikin calm before treatment. E don cough for 3 days. I count the pikin breath for one full minute after bronchodilator. After bronchodilator, chest no sink inside. After bronchodilator, pikin still calm. After bronchodilator, the respiratory rate na 42. Pulse oximeter no dey. E no get recurrent wheeze. The respiratory rate before bronchodilator na 45. E no get stridor when calm. E dey wheeze.
